conventions.sun: sunAzimuthDeg is measured in the horizontal plane from +X (west) toward +Z (north); sunElevationDeg is above the horizon; the direction toward the sun is [cos(e) cos(a), sin(e), cos(e) sin(a)]
conventions.colours: linear RGB; sunColor is multiplied by sunIntensity
conventions.blend: switching presets blends every value linearly (the sun direction as a vector, renormalised)
conventions.toneMapping: Khronos PBR Neutral with a fixed exposure per preset (no auto-exposure)
conventions.fog: The Fog preset keeps a dense marine layer at the water (visibility about 1.1 km at sea level) that thins with height, so both towers and the span read above it from the postcard; the fog banks are separate (banks, layout.json fogBanks). Fix round 1 (owner decision 2026-09-29) thinned hazeDensity from 1.7e-4 to 8e-5 and marineDensity from 5.5e-3 to 3.5e-3.
conventions.fields: envIntensity scales the sky's prefiltered environment; envSaturation is the chroma kept in it (1 = the visible sky's). overcast 0 is a clear sky and 1 fully overcast. fogColor is the in-scatter at the horizon away from the sun, fogSun the sun-side lobe of sharpness fogPower. hazeDensity (1/m at sea level) and hazeHeight (m scale height) are the exponential haze; marineDensity and marineHeight the marine layer. skyGain calibrates the clear-sky radiance. wind scales whitecaps and chop. banks is the fog-bank opacity, lights the vehicle lamps and lamps the bridge lamps and beacons (layout.json lights).
